description:
About the Fellowship

The Luxembourg Centre for Contemporary and Digital History (C²DH) is the University of Luxembourg's third interdisciplinary research centre, focusing on high-quality research, analysis and public dissemination in the field of contemporary history. It promotes an interdisciplinary approach with a particular focus on new digital methods and tools for historical research and teaching. The C²DH offers one short-term fellowship position for 2 months for a scholar at risk, including Palestine and Sudan.

Fellowship Benefits

  • Monthly reimbursement of EUR 1,200 for accommodation.
  • Monthly reimbursement of EUR 1,800 for daily costs.
  • The funding is supposed to cover all expenses including travel and insurance.
  • Office space and other relevant facilities provided by C²DH.
  • Fellows are expected to reside in Luxembourg or the Greater Region and will arrange their own accommodation.
  • Fellowship holder will be assigned to one of our Research departments and asked to present their current project in a seminar or colloquium.

Eligibility and Requirements

Following criteria established by the Scholars at Risk network, at-risk scholars are those who are experiencing, or experienced very recently, direct risk, such as threat of violence/harm to the individual, harassment/intimidation, threat of arrest/imprisonment, etc, or they are experiencing general physical risk from an active conflict in their country of origin that hinder them from fully and freely exercising their research and academic work.

Applicants are expected to pursue their own research, which can relate to any region in the world and is ideally related to contemporary, public or digital history, broadly understood.

Research Departments

  • Contemporary History of Luxembourg
  • Public History and Outreach
  • Contemporary History of Europe
  • Digital History and Historiography

Application Process

Apply online via the C²DH application portal. Selection decisions will be announced no later than mid-December 2026.

About Luxembourg Centre for Contemporary and Digital History (C²DH)

Luxembourg Centre for Contemporary and Digital History is a research centre at the University of Luxembourg. C²DH investigates contemporary history using historical scholarship and digital methods. Its researchers work on projects involving archives, data, media and public history, connecting academic inquiry with new approaches to presenting and understanding the past.

Official website: https://www.uni.lu/c2dh-en

https://www.uni.lu/c2dh-en/news/scholar-at-risk-fellowship-2027/

Important Notes

  • Short-term fellowship for 2 months in 2027.
  • Open to scholars at risk, including Palestine and Sudan.
  • The fellowship is intended to promote international exchanges and collaborations in the field of contemporary, public and digital history.
  • Fellows arrange their own accommodation and reside in Luxembourg or the Greater Region.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 31 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
